review_summary: Independent R1 reconciliation recomputed the CNY200,000 target total, -16.30% common-stress arithmetic and long-horizon formula values. It verified zero launch weights for REITs/direct stocks, deterministic q=0 fallback, separation of r from D0, and the distinction between stress arithmetic and observed DD_t controls.

findings.evidence: The prior annual-add formula used pre-contribution V and could send all added capital into dividend equity, exceeding the 35% hard cap.
findings.fix_required: Use post-contribution V-plus, capped gaps, an eligibility flag and a residual-to-protected-liquidity waterfall. Independently rerun deterministic A01--A03 tests.

findings.evidence: The prior model said REITs were zero until review but retained a live 5% target, allowing annual contributions to enter an ineligible sleeve.
findings.fix_required: Maintain mutually exclusive core and REIT-enabled target vectors. Set w_REIT and u_REIT to zero until all activation gates pass and recompute scenarios for both paths.

findings.evidence: The prior 25% liquidity sleeve mixed deposits with money-market fund/ETF exposure while every scenario used a zero cash shock. That earlier household-reserve framing is superseded by the user-defined full-principal model; current validation is governed by R1-A-006.
findings.fix_required: Historical closure retained. For the current model, verify protected internal liquidity and trading cash inside V, retain the transparent trading-cash haircut, and use R1-A-006 as the scope-consistency gate.

findings.evidence: The prior presentation had shocks only for the base variant and no broad-equity loss assumption for the growth vector.
findings.fix_required: Present a 12-month common shock table and recalculated conservative, core base, REIT-enabled base, core growth and REIT-enabled growth outcomes, with no probability claim.

findings.evidence: A 5% REIT sleeve cannot be attained using only two positions with a 2% per-name limit.
findings.fix_required: Require at least three independently approved holdings, each no more than 2%, or leave the full sleeve in high-quality rates when small-account trading economics fail.

findings.evidence: The former repair used a household cash-flow solvency bridge. An earlier capital-scope clarification removed that bridge and replaced it with a reinvestment-only D0/Dh sensitivity; the subsequent fixed-principal revision is governed by R1-A-007.
findings.fix_required: Historical closure retained. For the current model, independently verify D0/Dh is used only for reinvestment sensitivity and does not reintroduce an external reserve or spending-coverage test.

findings.evidence: All seven sleeves now publish active-vector w, upper-limit u and eligibility q rules. A04 recomputes a seven-sleeve target allocation and A05 demonstrates residual funds safely remaining in protected liquidity.
findings.fix_required: Use the same full-vector controls during any future implementation review.
